headline: Trippie Redd Says His Biggest Show Check Was $750K
body: Trippie Redd told N3on the most he has ever been paid for a performance was $750,000 for a show in Brazil. The clip is a quick window into how high festival and international booking numbers can climb for major rap acts when a strong touring market lines up with the right offer.
